```{r cars}
#Persistent vs Resolving
## --- Packages ---
library(DESeq2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

## --- Paths ---
counts_path  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/Featurecounts/counts_featureCounts_updated.txt"
coldata_path <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/KC_SAB_RNAseq_coldata_updated.csv"
out_path     <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/DESeq2_Day1_Persistent_vs_Resolving_PARTEK_MIRROR.csv"

## --- 1. Load and clean counts ---

counts_raw <- read.delim(counts_path, check.names = FALSE)

# Drop featureCounts summary rows like __no_feature, __ambiguous, etc. (if any)
counts_raw <- counts_raw[!grepl("^__", counts_raw$Geneid), ]

# Split annotation vs counts
counts_mat <- counts_raw[, -(1:6)]
rownames(counts_mat) <- counts_raw$Geneid

# Coerce to numeric
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_mat)
mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"

# Sanity check for NAs before subsetting
na_rows_global <- rowSums(is.na(counts_mat)) > 0
cat("Global NA rows in counts_mat:", sum(na_rows_global), "\n")

# Drop any genes with NA counts (those 6 rows)
counts_mat <- counts_mat[!na_rows_global, , drop = FALSE]

## --- 2. Load metadata ---

coldata <- read.csv(coldata_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Standardize sample column name
if ("Sample Name" %in% colnames(coldata)) {
  colnames(coldata)[colnames(coldata) == "Sample Name"] <- "Sample"
}

# Strip ".bam" suffix everywhere
colnames(counts_mat) <- gsub("\\.bam$", "", colnames(counts_mat))
coldata$Sample       <- gsub("\\.bam$", "", coldata$Sample)

## --- 3. Day 1 subset and sample matching ---

coldata_d1 <- subset(coldata, Day == 1)
rownames(coldata_d1) <- coldata_d1$Sample

common_samps <- intersect(colnames(counts_mat), rownames(coldata_d1))
cat("Day 1 samples in DESeq2:", length(common_samps), "\n")

counts_d1   <- counts_mat[, common_samps, drop = FALSE]
coldata_d1  <- coldata_d1[common_samps, , drop = FALSE]

# Quick NA check on Day 1 subset
cat("NA rows in Day1 subset:", sum(rowSums(is.na(counts_d1)) > 0), "\n")

## --- 4. Factor settings (Status: Persistent as reference) ---

coldata_d1$Status <- factor(coldata_d1$Status,
                            levels = c("Persistent", "Resolving"))
coldata_d1$Status <- droplevels(coldata_d1$Status)

## --- 5. Build DESeq2 object ---

dds_d1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_d1),
  colData   = coldata_d1,
  design    = ~ Status
)

## --- 6. Apply mean-count filter >= 1 (Partek lowest coverage filter) ---

keep <- rowMeans(counts(dds_d1)) >= 1
dds_d1 <- dds_d1[keep, ]

## --- 7. Run DESeq2 ---

dds_d1 <- DESeq(dds_d1)

## --- 8. Results: Persistent vs Resolving ---

res_d1 <- results(dds_d1, contrast = c("Status", "Persistent", "Resolving"))

# Drop rows with NA padj (unreliable estimates)
res_d1 <- res_d1[!is.na(res_d1$padj), ]

# Order and save
res_out_d1 <- as.data.frame(res_d1) %>%
  arrange(padj)

write.csv(res_out_d1, out_path, row.names = TRUE)

cat("Finished Day 1 DESeq2 Persistent vs Resolving.\n",
    "Results written to:\n", out_path, "\n")


```

```{r}

#volcano plot, padj
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

volcano_from_csv <- function(csv_file,
                             gene_col = "symbol",
                             lfc_col  = "log2FoldChange",
                             padj_col = "padj",
                             title    = "",
                             outfile  = "",
                             p_cutoff = 0.05,
                             lfc_cutoff = 1) {

  # Load CSV
  df <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Rename for convenience
  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      gene = !!gene_col,
      lfc  = !!lfc_col,
      padj = !!padj_col
    )

  # Remove missing padj
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(padj))

  # Compute -log10(padj)
  df$neglog10padj <- -log10(df$padj)

  # Sig flag
  df$sig <- with(df, padj < p_cutoff & abs(lfc) >= lfc_cutoff)

  # Label only significant
  df$label <- ifelse(df$sig, df$gene, NA)

  # Volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = sig), size = 1.5) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.3, `TRUE` = 1)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = label),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 30,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "log2 Fold Change (Persistent vs Resolving)",
      y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  if (outfile != "") {
    ggsave(outfile, p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  }

  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
#p value < 0.05, 2lfc
volcano_from_csv <- function(csv_file,
                             gene_col = "hgnc_symbol",
                             lfc_col  = "log2FoldChange",
                             p_col    = "pvalue",        # raw p-value
                             title    = "",
                             outfile  = "",
                             p_cutoff = 0.05,
                             lfc_cutoff = 2,
                             n_label_up = 15,            # how many to label
                             n_label_down = 15) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)

  df <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      gene = !!gene_col,
      lfc  = !!lfc_col,
      pval = !!p_col
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pval))

  df$neglog10p <- -log10(df$pval)

  # Direction categories
  df$direction <- "NS"
  df$direction[df$pval < p_cutoff & df$lfc >=  lfc_cutoff]  <- "Up in Persistent"
  df$direction[df$pval < p_cutoff & df$lfc <= -lfc_cutoff]  <- "Up in Resolving"

  df$direction <- factor(df$direction,
                         levels = c("Up in Resolving", "NS", "Up in Persistent"))

  # Choose which genes to label: top N up & down by p-value
  up_labels <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in Persistent") %>%
    arrange(pval) %>%
    head(n_label_up) %>%
    pull(gene)

  down_labels <- df %>%
    filter(direction == "Up in Resolving") %>%
    arrange(pval) %>%
    head(n_label_down) %>%
    pull(gene)

  label_genes <- c(up_labels, down_labels)

  df$label <- ifelse(df$gene %in% label_genes, df$gene, NA)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10p)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in Resolving" = "#1f78b4",
                                  "NS"              = "grey80",
                                  "Up in Persistent"= "#e31a1c")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = label),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 50,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "log2 Fold Change (Persistent vs Resolving)",
      y = "-log10(p-value)",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  if (outfile != "") {
    ggsave(outfile, p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  }

  p
}

```

```{r}
#heatmaps
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

heatmap_from_annotated_csv <- function(csv_file,
                                       dds,
                                       title,
                                       outfile,
                                       p_cutoff   = 0.05,
                                       lfc_cutoff = 2,
                                       max_genes  = 50) {

  # ---- 1. Read annotated results ----
  ann <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Sanity check: required columns
  stopifnot(all(c("pvalue", "log2FoldChange", "ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol") %in% colnames(ann)))

  # Filter by your thresholds (use pvalue; swap to padj if you prefer)
  ann_filt <- ann %>%
    filter(!is.na(pvalue),
           !is.na(log2FoldChange),
           pvalue < p_cutoff,
           abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff,
           !is.na(ensembl_gene_id))

  if (nrow(ann_filt) == 0) {
    message("No genes pass thresholds in annotated CSV; no heatmap created.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Order by p-value and take top N
  ann_filt <- ann_filt %>% arrange(pvalue)
  top_ann  <- head(ann_filt, max_genes)

  # ---- 2. Get VST expression from DESeq2 object ----
  vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
  mat <- assay(vsd)

  # *** Make dds rownames Ensembl-clean (strip version) ***
  ensembl_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(mat))
  rownames(mat) <- ensembl_clean

  # Keep genes in the same order as top_ann (nice for plotting)
  genes_use <- top_ann$ensembl_gene_id[top_ann$ensembl_gene_id %in% rownames(mat)]

  if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
    message("No overlap between dds rownames and annotated ensembl_gene_id.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  mat_sub <- mat[genes_use, , drop = FALSE]

  # ---- 3. Use HGNC symbols as rownames where available ----
  sym_map <- ann_filt %>%
    select(ensembl_gene_id, hgnc_symbol) %>%
    distinct()

  row_syms <- sym_map$hgnc_symbol[match(genes_use, sym_map$ensembl_gene_id)]

  # fallback to Ensembl if symbol is missing
  rownames(mat_sub) <- ifelse(is.na(row_syms) | row_syms == "",
                              genes_use,
                              row_syms)

  # Row-wise z-score
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_sub)))

  # ---- 4. Column annotation (Status + Day + Age + Sex) ----
  col_md <- as.data.frame(colData(dds))

  cols_to_use <- intersect(c("Status", "Age", "Sex"),
                           colnames(col_md))

  col_anno <- col_md[, cols_to_use, drop = FALSE]

  # Ensure annotation rows match column order of mat_z
  col_anno <- col_anno[colnames(mat_z), , drop = FALSE]

  # ---- 5. Plot heatmap ----
  pheatmap(mat_z,
           annotation_col = col_anno,
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           fontsize_row = 6,
           main = title,
           filename = outfile,
           width = 6,
           height = 8)
}
```

```{r}
###############################################
## STEP 1–4: FULL HGNC + VENN EXTRACTION PIPELINE
###############################################

library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)

## -------------------------
## INPUT: your Ensembl lists
## -------------------------
# (Replace these with your objects if names differ)
# trend_all   ← Days 1-3-5-7
# trend_d13   ← Day 1-3
# trend_d135  ← Day 1-3-5

clean_ids <- function(x) sub("\\..*", "", x)

ens_all  <- clean_ids(trend_all)
ens_d13  <- clean_ids(trend_d13)
ens_d135 <- clean_ids(trend_d135)

# union for mapping
ens_union <- unique(c(ens_all, ens_d13, ens_d135))

## -------------------------
## STEP 1 — Build Ensembl → HGNC mapping
## -------------------------

mart <- useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

mapping <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters    = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values     = ens_union,
  mart       = mart
)

# named vector for lookup
ens2sym <- setNames(mapping$hgnc_symbol, mapping$ensembl_gene_id)

# helper to convert Ensembl → HGNC and deduplicate
to_hgnc <- function(ens_vec) {
  ens_clean <- clean_ids(ens_vec)
  sym <- ens2sym[ens_clean]
  sym <- sym[!is.na(sym) & sym != ""]
  unique(sym)
}

## -------------------------
## STEP 2 — Convert all 3 lists to HGNC
## -------------------------

sym_all   <- to_hgnc(trend_all)   # Days 1-3-5-7
sym_d13   <- to_hgnc(trend_d13)   # Day 1-3
sym_d135  <- to_hgnc(trend_d135)  # Day 1-3-5

A <- sym_all
B <- sym_d13
C <- sym_d135

## -------------------------
## STEP 3 — Compute all 7 Venn regions in HGNC
## -------------------------

# 3-way overlap
ABC <- Reduce(intersect, list(A, B, C))

# pairwise-only
AB_only <- setdiff(intersect(A, B), C)
AC_only <- setdiff(intersect(A, C), B)
BC_only <- setdiff(intersect(B, C), A)

# unique sets
A_only <- setdiff(A, union(B, C))
B_only <- setdiff(B, union(A, C))
C_only <- setdiff(C, union(A, B))

## sanity check
print(sapply(
  list(A_only, B_only, C_only, AB_only, AC_only, BC_only, ABC),
  length
))

## -------------------------
## STEP 4 — Put all regions side-by-side + save CSV
## -------------------------

venn_lists_sym <- list(
  Days_1_3_5_7_only              = A_only,
  Day_1_3_only                   = B_only,
  Day_1_3_5_only                 = C_only,
  Overlap_Days_1_3_5_7_and_Day_1_3   = AB_only,
  Overlap_Days_1_3_5_7_and_Day_1_3_5 = AC_only,
  Overlap_Day_1_3_and_Day_1_3_5      = BC_only,
  Overlap_all_three              = ABC
)

max_len <- max(sapply(venn_lists_sym, length))

venn_df_sym <- as.data.frame(
  lapply(venn_lists_sym, function(x) {
    c(x, rep(NA, max_len - length(x)))
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  venn_df_sym,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/LRT_trajectory_Venn_regions_HGNC.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

################################################
## END OF FULL PIPELINE
################################################

```

```{r}
#Feb.18.26
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

counts_path  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/Featurecounts/counts_featureCounts_updated.txt"
coldata_path <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/KC_SAB_RNAseq_coldata_updated.csv"


out_counts_clean  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/counts_clean.tsv"
out_coldata_clean <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/coldata_clean.tsv"

# -------- helper: standardize sample IDs --------
clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- gsub("\r", "", x)          # remove hidden carriage returns
  x <- trimws(x)                 # remove leading/trailing spaces
  x <- sub("\\.bam$", "", x)     # drop .bam
  x
}

# =========================
# 1) COUNTS: load + extract sample names
# =========================
counts_raw <- read.delim(counts_path, check.names = FALSE)

stopifnot("ID" %in% colnames(counts_raw))          # your file uses ID
counts_raw <- counts_raw[!grepl("^__", counts_raw$ID), ]

# counts columns start after first 6 annotation columns
cts <- counts_raw[, -(1:6)]
gene_ids <- counts_raw$ID

colnames(cts) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(cts))

# checks
stopifnot(sum(colnames(cts) == "") == 0)
if (anyDuplicated(colnames(cts)) > 0) {
  dup <- unique(colnames(cts)[duplicated(colnames(cts))])
  stop(paste("Duplicate sample IDs in COUNTS after cleaning:", paste(dup, collapse = ", ")))
}

# =========================
# 2) COLDATA: load + clean sample column
# =========================
coldata <- read.csv(coldata_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(coldata) <- trimws(names(coldata))

if ("Sample Name" %in% names(coldata)) names(coldata)[names(coldata)=="Sample Name"] <- "Sample"
stopifnot("Sample" %in% names(coldata))

coldata$Sample <- clean_sample_id(coldata$Sample)

# checks
stopifnot(sum(coldata$Sample == "") == 0)
if (anyDuplicated(coldata$Sample) > 0) {
  dup <- unique(coldata$Sample[duplicated(coldata$Sample)])
  print(coldata %>% filter(Sample %in% dup))
  stop(paste("Duplicate sample IDs in COLDATA after cleaning:", paste(dup, collapse = ", ")))
}

# =========================
# 3) ALIGN: keep only common samples, reorder
# =========================
common <- intersect(colnames(cts), coldata$Sample)
cat("Samples in counts:", ncol(cts), "\n")
cat("Samples in coldata:", nrow(coldata), "\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common), "\n")

# keep & reorder counts
cts <- cts[, common, drop = FALSE]

# keep & reorder coldata to match counts
coldata2 <- coldata %>% filter(Sample %in% common) %>% arrange(match(Sample, common))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts), coldata2$Sample))

# =========================
# 4) SAVE cleaned outputs
# =========================
cts_out <- as.data.frame(cts)
cts_out <- cbind(ID = gene_ids, cts_out)

write.table(cts_out, out_counts_clean, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
write.table(coldata2, out_coldata_clean, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

cat("Saved:\n", out_counts_clean, "\n", out_coldata_clean, "\n")
```

```{r}
resLRT <- results(dds_lrt)
summary(resLRT)

# -------------------------
# 1) Significant LRT genes
# -------------------------
# -------------------------
# 1) Significant LRT genes (raw p < 0.05)
# -------------------------
sig_LRT <- resLRT[!is.na(resLRT$pvalue) & resLRT$pvalue < 0.05, ]

sig_genes <- rownames(sig_LRT)
cat("Significant trajectory genes (p < 0.05):", length(sig_genes), "\n")

stopifnot(length(sig_genes) > 1)

# -------------------------
# 2) VST transform
# -------------------------
vsd <- vst(dds_lrt, blind = FALSE)
norm_mat <- assay(vsd)[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 3) DEGreport clustering
# -------------------------
library(DEGreport)

cluster_mat <- norm_mat
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_lrt))

meta$Day <- factor(as.character(meta$Day), levels = c("1","3","5","7"))
meta$Status <- factor(meta$Status)

clusters <- degPatterns(
  cluster_mat,
  metadata = meta,
  time     = "Day",
  col      = "Status"
)

# gene-to-cluster mapping
head(clusters$df)

# trajectory plot
clusters$plot
```

```{r}
# 3.10.26
#running full analysis on all days Days 1-9

library(DESeq2)
library(DEGreport)

# -------------------------
# 0) Load metadata fresh
# -------------------------
coldata <- read.delim(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/coldata_clean.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coldata$Sample <- trimws(gsub("\r", "", coldata$Sample))
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$Sample

# -------------------------
# 1) Load counts fresh
# -------------------------
counts_df <- read.delim(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/counts_clean.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(counts_df)[1] <- "ID"
counts_df$ID <- trimws(as.character(counts_df$ID))
counts_df <- counts_df[!is.na(counts_df$ID) & counts_df$ID != "", , drop = FALSE]
rownames(counts_df) <- counts_df$ID
counts_df$ID <- NULL
colnames(counts_df) <- trimws(gsub("\r", "", colnames(counts_df)))
counts_df[] <- lapply(counts_df, function(x) as.numeric(trimws(as.character(x))))
counts_df <- counts_df[complete.cases(counts_df), , drop = FALSE]

counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df)
storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"

# -------------------------
# 2) Create NEW any-day metadata
# -------------------------
coldata_anyday <- coldata
coldata_anyday$Day_raw <- coldata_anyday$Day
coldata_anyday$Day_clean <- trimws(as.character(coldata_anyday$Day_raw))
coldata_anyday$Day_clean <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", coldata_anyday$Day_clean)
coldata_anyday$Day_clean[coldata_anyday$Day_clean == ""] <- NA

coldata_anyday$Day <- factor(coldata_anyday$Day_clean)
coldata_anyday$Status <- factor(coldata_anyday$Status)
coldata_anyday <- coldata_anyday[!is.na(coldata_anyday$Day) & !is.na(coldata_anyday$Status), , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 3) Match metadata and counts
# -------------------------
common_samples_anyday <- rownames(coldata_anyday)[rownames(coldata_anyday) %in% colnames(counts_mat)]
coldata_anyday_matched <- coldata_anyday[common_samples_anyday, , drop = FALSE]
counts_anyday_matched  <- counts_mat[, common_samples_anyday, drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 4) Keep only days with BOTH statuses represented
# -------------------------
tab <- table(coldata_anyday_matched$Status, coldata_anyday_matched$Day)
valid_days <- colnames(tab)[colSums(tab == 0) == 0]

coldata_anyday_balanced <- coldata_anyday_matched[coldata_anyday_matched$Day %in% valid_days, , drop = FALSE]
coldata_anyday_balanced$Day <- droplevels(coldata_anyday_balanced$Day)
coldata_anyday_balanced$Status <- droplevels(coldata_anyday_balanced$Status)

counts_anyday_balanced <- counts_anyday_matched[, rownames(coldata_anyday_balanced), drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(coldata_anyday_balanced), colnames(counts_anyday_balanced)))
stopifnot(sum(is.na(counts_anyday_balanced)) == 0)

cat("Days kept for interaction model:\n")
print(valid_days)

cat("Final balanced sample table:\n")
print(table(coldata_anyday_balanced$Status, coldata_anyday_balanced$Day))

# -------------------------
# 5) DESeq2 any-day LRT
# -------------------------
dds_anyday <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_anyday_balanced,
  colData   = coldata_anyday_balanced,
  design    = ~ Status + Day + Status:Day
)

keep_anyday <- rowSums(counts(dds_anyday) >= 10) >= 3
dds_anyday <- dds_anyday[keep_anyday, ]

dds_lrt_anyday <- DESeq(
  dds_anyday,
  test    = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ Status + Day
)

resLRT_anyday <- results(dds_lrt_anyday)
summary(resLRT_anyday)

# -------------------------
# 6) Significant genes
# -------------------------
sig_LRT_anyday <- resLRT_anyday[!is.na(resLRT_anyday$pvalue) & resLRT_anyday$pvalue < 0.05, ]
sig_genes_anyday <- rownames(sig_LRT_anyday)

cat("Significant trajectory genes (raw p < 0.05):", length(sig_genes_anyday), "\n")

# -------------------------
# 7) VST + clustering
# -------------------------
vsd_anyday <- vst(dds_lrt_anyday, blind = FALSE)
norm_mat_anyday <- assay(vsd_anyday)[sig_genes_anyday, , drop = FALSE]

meta_anyday <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_lrt_anyday))
meta_anyday$Day <- droplevels(meta_anyday$Day)
meta_anyday$Status <- droplevels(meta_anyday$Status)

clusters_anyday <- degPatterns(
  norm_mat_anyday,
  metadata = meta_anyday,
  time     = "Day",
  col      = "Status"
)

head(clusters_anyday$df)
clusters_anyday$plot

# gene-to-cluster table
gene_cluster_table <- clusters_anyday$df[, c("genes", "cluster")]
colnames(gene_cluster_table) <- c("Gene", "Cluster")

# sort nicely
gene_cluster_table <- gene_cluster_table[order(gene_cluster_table$Cluster, gene_cluster_table$Gene), ]

# also keep a CSV version if wanted
write.csv(
  gene_cluster_table,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/DeSeq2_LRT_genes_by_cluster_Days1-9.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plot_gene_vst <- function(gene, vsd, meta, mapping) {

  gene_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", gene)
  symbol <- mapping[gene_clean]

  if (is.na(symbol) || symbol == "") {
    symbol <- gene_clean
  }

  df <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(meta),
    Status = meta$Status,
    Day    = factor(as.character(meta$Day), levels = c("1","3","5","7")),
    expr   = as.numeric(assay(vsd)[gene, rownames(meta)])
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Day, y = expr, group = Status, color = Status)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0(symbol, " (", gene_clean, ")"),
         y = "VST expression") +
    theme_classic()
}

pdf("/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/Cluster9_individual_gene_plots_VST_HGNC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

for (g in genes_c9) {
  print(plot_gene_vst(g, vsd, meta, ensg_to_symbol))
}

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# 1) VST full (already did)
vsd_all <- vst(dds_lrt, blind = FALSE)
mat_all <- assay(vsd_all)

# 2) Pick HVGs by variance across ALL samples
vars_all <- rowVars(mat_all)
topN <- 5000   # try 5000 first; 10000 if you want more coverage
```

```{r}
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

f1_pos_symbols <- c("ANKRD22","ZDHHC19","GPR84","CD177","MCEMP1","TNFAIP6","IL1R2","FCGR1A","KCNMA1","BATF2","S100A12","S100A8","ANXA3","CASP5","CEACAM1","TMT1B","OLAH","HP","CD274")
f1_neg_symbols <- c("PRSS33","ALOX15","TCF7","CD8B","TRAC","LINC00402","EEIG1","CD8A","CD6","LINC00861","GZMK","SIGLEC8","CD3E","LOC105377225","CXCR3","TRBC1","CD40LG","TRBC2","CD5","TRBV5-1")
f3_pos_symbols <- c("RSAD2","OAS3","IFI44L","IFIT1","IFI44","IFI6","EPSTI1","SIGLEC1","OAS2","HERC5","GBP5","GBP1","OAS1","P2RY14","MX1","BATF2","CMPK2")
f3_neg_symbols <- c("ELANE","AZU1","CHIT1","LCN2","CTSG","BPI","DEFA4","PRTN3","CEACAM8","LTF","MS4A3","MPO","MMP8","CAMP","ORM1","TCN1","CEACAM6","COL17A1","CRISP3")

# --- helper: SYMBOL -> ENSG (unversioned) ---
sym_to_ensg <- function(sym_vec) {
  ensg <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keys = unique(sym_vec),
                 column = "ENSEMBL",
                 keytype = "SYMBOL",
                 multiVals = "first")
  ensg <- ensg[!is.na(ensg)]
  data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ensg), ENSG = unname(ensg), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# --- cluster mapping table from degPatterns HVG run ---
df_map <- clusters_hvg$df  # columns: genes, cluster
df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)  # strip version if present

# --- function: map a SYMBOL set to clusters ---
map_set_to_clusters <- function(sym_set, set_name) {
  m <- sym_to_ensg(sym_set)
  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by = "ENSG")
  hit <- hit[order(hit$cluster, hit$SYMBOL), ]

  cat("\n============================\n", set_name, "\n============================\n", sep="")
  cat("Input symbols:", length(sym_set), "\n")
  cat("Mapped to ENSG:", nrow(m), "\n")
  cat("Found in HVG clusters:", nrow(hit), "\n\n")

  if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
    cat("None of these genes are in the top-5000 HVGs used for clustering.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  print(hit[, c("SYMBOL","genes","cluster")], row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nCounts per cluster:\n")
  print(sort(table(hit$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))

  invisible(hit)
}

# --- run mapping for each set ---
hit_f1_pos <- map_set_to_clusters(f1_pos_symbols, "Factor1 POS")
hit_f1_neg <- map_set_to_clusters(f1_neg_symbols, "Factor1 NEG")
hit_f3_pos <- map_set_to_clusters(f3_pos_symbols, "Factor3 POS")
hit_f3_neg <- map_set_to_clusters(f3_neg_symbols, "Factor3 NEG")
```

```{r}
############################################
# Attach DESeq2 LRT p-values to MEFISTO genes
############################################

# Prepare LRT results table
lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT)
lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$","", rownames(lrt_df))

# Helper function
add_pvals <- function(hit_table, set_name) {

  if (is.null(hit_table) || nrow(hit_table) == 0) {
    cat("\n", set_name, ": no genes to test\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  merged <- merge(hit_table, lrt_df,
                  by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE)

  merged <- merged[order(merged$pvalue), ]

  cat("\n============================\n", set_name, "\n============================\n", sep="")
  print(merged[, c("SYMBOL","cluster","pvalue","padj")], row.names=FALSE)

  invisible(merged)
}

lrt_f1_pos <- add_pvals(hit_f1_pos, "Factor1 POS")
lrt_f1_neg <- add_pvals(hit_f1_neg, "Factor1 NEG")
lrt_f3_pos <- add_pvals(hit_f3_pos, "Factor3 POS")
lrt_f3_neg <- add_pvals(hit_f3_neg, "Factor3 NEG")
```

```{r}
############################################
# Save MEFISTO Factor 1 & 3 gene lists
############################################

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(MOFA2)
# Get weights matrix
W <- get_weights(obj, views="RNA", as.data.frame=FALSE)$RNA

# Helper to process a factor
process_factor <- function(factor_number, factor_name, top_n = NULL) {

  weights <- W[, factor_number]

  df <- data.frame(
    ENSG_version = names(weights),
    Weight = weights,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # strip version
  df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df$ENSG_version)

  # Add SYMBOL
  df$SYMBOL <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                      keys = df$ENSG,
                      column = "SYMBOL",
                      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                      multiVals = "first")

  # Split positive / negative
  df_pos <- df[df$Weight > 0, ]
  df_neg <- df[df$Weight < 0, ]

  # Order by magnitude
  df_pos <- df_pos[order(-df_pos$Weight), ]
  df_neg <- df_neg[order(df_neg$Weight), ]

  # Optional: limit to top_n by absolute magnitude
  if (!is.null(top_n)) {
    df_pos <- head(df_pos, top_n)
    df_neg <- head(df_neg, top_n)
  }

  # Save
  write.csv(df_pos,
            paste0("MEFISTO_", factor_name, "_POS.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  write.csv(df_neg,
            paste0("MEFISTO_", factor_name, "_NEG.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nSaved:", factor_name, "\n")
  cat("Positive genes:", nrow(df_pos), "\n")
  cat("Negative genes:", nrow(df_neg), "\n")

  invisible(list(pos=df_pos, neg=df_neg))
}

# ---- Run for Factor 1 and Factor 3 ----
f1_lists <- process_factor(1, "Factor1")
f3_lists <- process_factor(3, "Factor3")
```

```{r}
                 keytype = "SYMBOL",

  cat("Mapped to ENSG:", nrow(m), "\n")
  cat("Found in top-5000 HVG clusters:", nrow(hit2), "\n")

    cat("\nCounts per cluster:\n")
    print(sort(table(hit2$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))
    cat("\nTop genes by smallest LRT p-value:\n")
    print(head(hit2[, c("SYMBOL","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")], 25), row.names=FALSE)
  }
  hit2
}
```

```{r}
############################################
# Save MEFISTO hit tables (clusters + optional LRT p-values) to CSV
############################################

# Optional: attach LRT p-values if your hit tables have ENSG column
# If they DON'T have ENSG, we can derive it from 'genes' or add it safely.

lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT)
lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

add_lrt <- function(hit) {
  if (is.null(hit) || nrow(hit) == 0) return(hit)

  # Ensure ENSG exists
  if (!"ENSG" %in% colnames(hit)) {
    if ("genes" %in% colnames(hit)) hit$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", hit$genes)
    else if ("ENSG_version" %in% colnames(hit)) hit$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", hit$ENSG_version)
  }

  if (!"ENSG" %in% colnames(hit)) return(hit)  # can't attach

  merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by="ENSG", all.x=TRUE)
}

# Save raw cluster-mapped tables
```

```{r}
############################################
# Robust: read MSigDB/GSEA file + map to clusters + attach LRT
############################################
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# ---------- 1) Robust gene set reader ----------
read_msigdb_geneset <- function(path) {
  # Try as TSV table first
  tab <- try(read.delim(path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
             silent = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(tab, "try-error")) {
    # Case A: key/value style (2 columns)
    if (ncol(tab) >= 2 && any(tab[[1]] == "GENE_SYMBOLS")) {
      gene_str <- tab[tab[[1]] == "GENE_SYMBOLS", 2][1]
      return(trimws(unlist(strsplit(gene_str, ","))))
    }

    # Case B: wide single-row format with a column named GENE_SYMBOLS
    if ("GENE_SYMBOLS" %in% colnames(tab)) {
      gene_str <- tab$GENE_SYMBOLS[1]
      return(trimws(unlist(strsplit(gene_str, ","))))
    }
  }

  # Fallback: line-based parsing
  x <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  gene_line <- x[grepl("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\b", x)]

  # Sometimes it's "GENE_SYMBOLS\t...." not space
  if (length(gene_line) != 1) stop("Could not uniquely find GENE_SYMBOLS in file: ", path)

  gene_str <- sub("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\s*", "", gene_line)
  gene_str <- sub("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\t*", "", gene_str)
  trimws(unlist(strsplit(gene_str, ",")))
}

# ---------- 2) Robust analyzer (does NOT assume columns exist) ----------
analyze_list_safe <- function(symbols, list_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  # clusters df: must have genes + cluster
  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes","cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))

  # Add cleaned ENSG column
  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  # LRT df
  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  # SYMBOL -> ENSG
  ensg <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keys = unique(symbols),
                 column = "ENSEMBL",
                 keytype = "SYMBOL",
                 multiVals = "first")
  ensg <- ensg[!is.na(ensg)]
  m <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ensg), ENSG = unname(ensg), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Map into clusters
  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by = "ENSG")

  # Attach pvalues/padj
  hit2 <- merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE)
  hit2 <- hit2[order(hit2$pvalue), ]

  cat("\n====================\n", list_name, "\n====================\n", sep="")
  cat("Input symbols:", length(symbols), "\n")
  cat("Mapped to ENSG:", nrow(m), "\n")
  cat("Found in clustered set:", nrow(hit2), "\n")
  if (nrow(hit2) > 0) {
    cat("\nCounts per cluster:\n")
    print(sort(table(hit2$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))
    cat("\nTop genes by smallest LRT p-value:\n")
    print(head(hit2[, c("SYMBOL","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")], 25), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  hit2
}
```

```{r}
############################################
# Robust mapping for gene sets (handles 1:many and 0 mappings)
############################################
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

analyze_list_safe2 <- function(symbols, list_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  # clean symbols
  symbols <- unique(trimws(symbols))
  symbols <- symbols[nzchar(symbols)]

  # clusters df: must have genes + cluster
  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes","cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))
  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  # LRT df
  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  # SYMBOL -> ENSEMBL mapping (explicit, supports 1:many)
  m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = symbols,
    columns  = c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL"),
    keytype  = "SYMBOL"
  )
  m <- m[!is.na(m$ENSEMBL) & !is.na(m$SYMBOL), c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL")]
  m <- unique(m)
  colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "ENSEMBL"] <- "ENSG"

  cat("\n====================\n", list_name, "\n====================\n", sep="")
  cat("Input symbols:", length(symbols), "\n")
  cat("Mapped SYMBOL->ENSG rows:", nrow(m), "\n")

  if (nrow(m) == 0) {
    cat("No symbols mapped to ENSEMBL. Returning empty table.\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  # Map into clusters
  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by="ENSG")

  cat("Found in clustered set:", nrow(hit), "\n")
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
    cat("No mapped genes overlap the clustered genes. Returning empty table.\n")
    return(data.frame())
  }

  # Attach pvalues/padj
  hit2 <- merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by="ENSG", all.x=TRUE)
  hit2 <- hit2[order(hit2$pvalue), ]

  cat("\nCounts per cluster:\n")
  print(sort(table(hit2$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))

  cat("\nTop genes by smallest LRT p-value:\n")
  print(head(hit2[, c("SYMBOL","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")], 25), row.names=FALSE)

  hit2
}
```

```{r}
# Day ordering

meta$Status <- factor(meta$Status)

# Expression matrix (all genes x samples)

# Genes to plot (use the exact IDs in res_mito$genes when possible)
genes_to_plot <- unique(res_mito$genes)
genes_to_plot <- genes_to_plot[!is.na(genes_to_plot)]

# Helper: match ENSG IDs even if version differs
strip_ver <- function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x)

rownames_clean <- strip_ver(rownames(expr_all))
genes_clean <- strip_ver(genes_to_plot)

# Build a mapping from requested gene IDs -> actual rownames present in expr_all
map_idx <- match(genes_clean, rownames_clean)
keep <- !is.na(map_idx)

if (sum(keep) == 0) stop("None of the res_mito genes were found in vsd/expr matrix.")

genes_found <- genes_to_plot[keep]

# Plot loop: one gene per file
for (i in seq_along(row_ids_found)) {

  gene_row <- row_ids_found[i]
  gene_req <- genes_found[i]

  # get SYMBOL if available
  sym <- NA
  if ("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(res_mito)) {
    sym <- res_mito$SYMBOL[match(gene_req, res_mito$genes)]
    if (length(sym) == 0) sym <- NA
  }

  df <- data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(expr_all),
    Expr   = as.numeric(expr_all[gene_row, ]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  df <- merge(df, meta, by = "Sample")

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Day, y = Expr, color = Status, group = Status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.1) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(

      y = "VST expression",
      x = "Day"
    )

  ggsave(out_png, p, width = 6.5, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
############################################
# NEW ANALYSIS: Days 1–3 only (separate objects)
############################################

library(DESeq2)
library(matrixStats)
library(DEGreport)

# -------------------------
# 1) Subset metadata to Days 1 and 3
# -------------------------

coldata_13 <- coldata[coldata$Day %in% c("1","3"), ]
cts_13 <- cts[, rownames(coldata_13)]

coldata_13$Status <- factor(coldata_13$Status)
coldata_13$Day_13 <- factor(as.character(coldata_13$Day), levels = c("1","3"))

# -------------------------
# 2) Create DESeq object (new name!)
# -------------------------

dds_13 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = cts_13,
  colData   = coldata_13,
  design    = ~ Status + Day_13 + Status:Day_13
)

# Basic gene filter
keep_13 <- rowSums(counts(dds_13) >= 10) >= 3
dds_13  <- dds_13[keep_13, ]

# -------------------------
# 3) LRT for interaction
# -------------------------

dds_lrt_13 <- DESeq(
  dds_13,
  test    = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ Status + Day_13
)

resLRT_13 <- results(dds_lrt_13)
summary(resLRT_13)

# -------------------------
# 4) Significant genes (raw p < 0.05)
# -------------------------

sig_LRT_13 <- resLRT_13[
  !is.na(resLRT_13$pvalue) & resLRT_13$pvalue < 0.05,
]

sig_genes_13 <- rownames(sig_LRT_13)

cat("Significant trajectory genes (Days 1–3):",
    length(sig_genes_13), "\n")

# -------------------------
# 5) VST transform
# -------------------------

vsd_13 <- vst(dds_lrt_13, blind = FALSE)

norm_mat_13 <- assay(vsd_13)[sig_genes_13, , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 6) Clustering (Days 1–3 only)
# -------------------------

meta_13 <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_lrt_13))
meta_13$Day_13 <- factor(meta_13$Day_13, levels = c("1","3"))
meta_13$Status <- factor(meta_13$Status)

clusters_13 <- degPatterns(
  norm_mat_13,
  metadata = meta_13,
  time     = "Day_13",
  col      = "Status"
)

# View clusters
head(clusters_13$df)

# Plot
clusters_13$plot
```

```{r}
############################################################
# FEBRUARY 24TH 2026 -RUN ALL HALLMARK TSV GENE SETS AGAINST DESEQ2 LRT CLUSTERS DAY 1-7, p < 0.05
############################################################


library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# --- MSigDB v2026.1 .tsv format reader (key<TAB>value; genes in GENE_SYMBOLS or SOURCE_MEMBERS) ---
read_msigdb_tsv_symbols <- function(tsv_path) {
  lines <- readLines(tsv_path, warn = FALSE)

  # Prefer GENE_SYMBOLS; fallback to SOURCE_MEMBERS
  gs_line <- grep("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) gs_line <- grep("^SOURCE_MEMBERS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) return(character(0))

  # Split value (after tab) by comma
  val <- sub("^[^\t]*\t", "", gs_line[1])
  syms <- unlist(strsplit(val, ",", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE)
  syms <- unique(trimws(syms))
  syms[nzchar(syms)]
}

# --- Core mapping: SYMBOL -> ENSG -> cluster (+ optional LRT p/padj) ---
map_symbols_to_clusters <- function(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  symbols <- unique(trimws(as.character(symbols)))
  symbols <- symbols[nzchar(symbols)]
  if (length(symbols) == 0) return(data.frame())

  # cluster gene->cluster mapping
  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes","cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))
  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  # LRT results
  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  # SYMBOL -> ENSEMBL (1:many safe)
  m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = symbols,
    columns  = c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL"),
    keytype  = "SYMBOL"
  )
  m <- m[!is.na(m$SYMBOL) & !is.na(m$ENSEMBL), c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL")]
  m <- unique(m)
  colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "ENSEMBL"] <- "ENSG"
  if (nrow(m) == 0) return(data.frame())

  # overlap with clustered genes
  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by = "ENSG")
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) return(data.frame())

  # attach LRT stats (optional but usually helpful)
  hit2 <- merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by="ENSG", all.x=TRUE)

  hit2$geneset <- set_name
  hit2 <- hit2[, c("geneset","SYMBOL","ENSG","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")]
  hit2[order(hit2$geneset, hit2$cluster, hit2$pvalue), ]
}

# --- WRAPPER: run every TSV in a directory and write ONE combined gene-level CSV ---
run_all_msigdb_tsvs_to_clusters <- function(tsv_dir, out_csv, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj,
                                           pattern="\\.tsv$") {

  files <- list.files(tsv_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

  all_hits <- list()

  for (f in files) {
    set_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    symbols  <- read_msigdb_tsv_symbols(f)

    cat("\n---", set_name, "---\n")
    cat("Input symbols:", length(symbols), "\n")

    hit2 <- map_symbols_to_clusters(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj)

    cat("Mapped rows:", nrow(hit2), "\n")
    if (nrow(hit2) > 0) {
      cat("Unique ENSG mapped:", length(unique(hit2$ENSG)), "\n")
      cat("Cluster counts (unique ENSG):\n")
      print(sort(table(unique(hit2[, c("ENSG","cluster")])$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))
      all_hits[[set_name]] <- hit2
    }
  }

  out <- if (length(all_hits) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_hits) else data.frame()
  write.csv(out, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nWrote combined gene-level mappings to:\n", out_csv, "\n")
  invisible(out)
}

#PATHS

tsv_dir <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/GSEA_Hallmark_Genes"
# choose an output DIRECTORY
out_dir <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/GSEA_Hallmark_Genes/DESeq2_LRT_Cluster_Results"

# make sure it exists
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# choose an output FILE inside it
out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, "HALLMARK_all_geneLevel_LRTclusters.csv")

# then run
all_gene_mappings <- run_all_msigdb_tsvs_to_clusters(
  tsv_dir      = tsv_dir,
  out_csv      = out_csv,
  clusters_obj = clusters,
  resLRT_obj   = resLRT
)
```

```{r}
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

read_msigdb_tsv_symbols <- function(tsv_path) {
  lines <- readLines(tsv_path, warn = FALSE)

  gs_line <- grep("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) gs_line <- grep("^SOURCE_MEMBERS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) return(character(0))

  val <- sub("^[^\t]*\t", "", gs_line[1])
  syms <- unlist(strsplit(val, ",", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE)
  syms <- unique(trimws(syms))
  syms[nzchar(syms)]
}

map_symbols_to_clusters <- function(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  symbols <- unique(trimws(as.character(symbols)))
  symbols <- symbols[nzchar(symbols)]
  if (length(symbols) == 0) return(data.frame())

  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes","cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))
  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = symbols,
    columns  = c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL"),
    keytype  = "SYMBOL"
  )
  m <- m[!is.na(m$SYMBOL) & !is.na(m$ENSEMBL), c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL")]
  m <- unique(m)
  colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "ENSEMBL"] <- "ENSG"
  if (nrow(m) == 0) return(data.frame())

  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by = "ENSG")
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) return(data.frame())

  hit2 <- merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by="ENSG", all.x=TRUE)

  hit2$geneset <- set_name
  hit2 <- hit2[, c("geneset","SYMBOL","ENSG","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")]
  hit2[order(hit2$geneset, hit2$cluster, hit2$pvalue), ]
}

run_all_msigdb_tsvs_to_clusters <- function(tsv_dir, out_csv, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj,
                                           pattern="\\.tsv$") {

  files <- list.files(tsv_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

  all_hits <- list()

  for (f in files) {
    set_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    symbols  <- read_msigdb_tsv_symbols(f)

    cat("\n---", set_name, "(Day 1–3) ---\n")
    cat("Input symbols:", length(symbols), "\n")

    hit2 <- map_symbols_to_clusters(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj)

    cat("Mapped rows:", nrow(hit2), "\n")
    if (nrow(hit2) > 0) {
      cat("Unique ENSG mapped:", length(unique(hit2$ENSG)), "\n")
      cat("Cluster counts (unique ENSG):\n")
      print(sort(table(unique(hit2[, c("ENSG","cluster")])$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))
      all_hits[[set_name]] <- hit2
    }
  }

  out <- if (length(all_hits) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_hits) else data.frame()
  write.csv(out, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nWrote combined gene-level mappings to:\n", out_csv, "\n")
  invisible(out)
}
```

```{r}
#connecting xCell type to these sig hallmark genes to LRT clusters

############################################################
# Robust xCell CSV reader + annotate BOTH LRT hallmark CSVs
############################################################

# ---------- EDIT THESE PATHS ----------
xcell_file <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/xcell_results/xCell_cell_to_genes_supp.csv"

lrt_all_days_csv <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/GSEA_Hallmark_Genes/DESeq2_LRT_Cluster_Results/HALLMARK_all_geneLevel_LRTclusters_sig.csv"
lrt_day13_csv    <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/GSEA_Hallmark_Genes/DESeq2_LRT_Cluster_Results/HALLMARK_all_geneLevel_LRTclusters_Day1-3_2026-02-24_sig.csv"

out_dir <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/GSEA_Hallmark_Genes/DESeq2_LRT_Cluster_Results"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

############################################################
# 1) Build SYMBOL -> xCell_cell_type map (ROBUST)
############################################################
build_xcell_symbol_map <- function(xcell_path) {

  # --- Try comma CSV ---
  x <- tryCatch(
    read.csv(xcell_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  # --- If 1 column, try semicolon CSV (common Excel export) ---
  if (is.null(x) || ncol(x) < 2) {
    x <- tryCatch(
      read.csv(xcell_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, sep = ";"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  }

  # --- If STILL 1 column, parse lines manually ---
  if (is.null(x) || ncol(x) < 2) {
    lines <- readLines(xcell_path, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    if (length(lines) < 2) stop("xCell file looks empty or unreadable: ", xcell_path)

    # Detect delimiter from header
    header <- lines[1]
    delim <- if (grepl(";", header, fixed = TRUE)) ";" else ","

    parts <- strsplit(lines, delim, fixed = TRUE)
    max_len <- max(lengths(parts))
    mat <- t(vapply(parts, function(p) { length(p) <- max_len; p }, character(max_len)))

    x <- as.data.frame(mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

    # Set header
    colnames(x) <- x[1, ]
    x <- x[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (ncol(x) < 2) stop("Could not read xCell file into >=2 columns. Check delimiter/format.")

  # Assume wide format: col1=celltype, col2=# genes (optional), rest=genes
  celltype_col <- colnames(x)[1]

  # Determine if column 2 is numeric-ish (# genes)
  second_col_numeric <- suppressWarnings(all(is.na(x[[2]]) | !is.na(as.numeric(as.character(x[[2]])))))
  gene_cols <- if (second_col_numeric) 3:ncol(x) else 2:ncol(x)

  long_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) {
    ct <- as.character(x[i, celltype_col])
    syms <- unlist(x[i, gene_cols], use.names = FALSE)
    syms <- unique(trimws(as.character(syms)))
    syms <- syms[nzchar(syms)]
    if (length(syms) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(SYMBOL = syms, xCell_cell_type = ct, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  long <- do.call(rbind, long_list)
  if (is.null(long) || nrow(long) == 0) stop("Parsed xCell table but found 0 gene symbols. Check file contents.")

  # collapse SYMBOL -> "ct1;ct2;..."
  agg <- aggregate(xCell_cell_type ~ SYMBOL, data = long, FUN = function(v) {
    paste(sort(unique(v)), collapse = ";")
  })

  cat("xCell map built. Unique SYMBOLs:", nrow(agg), "\n")
  agg
}

############################################################
# 2) Annotate an LRT hallmark CSV
############################################################
annotate_lrt_with_xcell <- function(lrt_csv, xcell_map, out_csv) {
  df <- read.csv(lrt_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  if (!("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(df))) stop("Your LRT CSV must have a SYMBOL column: ", lrt_csv)

  df2 <- merge(df, xcell_map, by = "SYMBOL", all.x = TRUE)

  # put xCell_cell_type after ENSG if present
  if ("ENSG" %in% colnames(df2)) {
    cols <- colnames(df2)
    cols <- cols[cols != "xCell_cell_type"]
    ensg_i <- match("ENSG", cols)
    new_order <- append(cols, "xCell_cell_type", after = ensg_i)
    df2 <- df2[, new_order]
  }

  write.csv(df2, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Wrote:", out_csv, "\n")
  invisible(df2)
}

############################################################
# RUN
############################################################
xcell_map <- build_xcell_symbol_map(xcell_file)

out_all <- file.path(out_dir, "HALLMARK_all_geneLevel_LRTclusters_ALLDAYS_sig_xCellAnnotated.csv")
out_13  <- file.path(out_dir, "HALLMARK_all_geneLevel_LRTclusters_Day1-3_sig_xCellAnnotated.csv")

annotate_lrt_with_xcell(lrt_all_days_csv, xcell_map, out_all)
annotate_lrt_with_xcell(lrt_day13_csv,    xcell_map, out_13)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# 2) Read MSigDB Hallmark TSV symbols
############################################################
read_msigdb_tsv_symbols <- function(tsv_path) {
  lines <- readLines(tsv_path, warn = FALSE)

  gs_line <- grep("^GENE_SYMBOLS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) gs_line <- grep("^SOURCE_MEMBERS\\t", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(gs_line) == 0) return(character(0))

  val <- sub("^[^\t]*\t", "", gs_line[1])
  syms <- unlist(strsplit(val, ",", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE)
  syms <- unique(trimws(syms))
  syms[nzchar(syms)]
}

############################################################
# 3) Build base LRT cluster table with SYMBOL
############################################################
build_lrt_cluster_table <- function(clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes", "cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))

  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  # ENSG -> SYMBOL
  sym_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = unique(df_map$ENSG),
    columns  = c("ENSEMBL", "SYMBOL"),
    keytype  = "ENSEMBL"
  )

  sym_map <- sym_map[!is.na(sym_map$ENSEMBL) & !is.na(sym_map$SYMBOL), ]
  sym_map <- unique(sym_map)
  colnames(sym_map)[colnames(sym_map) == "ENSEMBL"] <- "ENSG"

  base <- merge(df_map[, c("genes", "ENSG", "cluster")], sym_map, by = "ENSG")
  base <- merge(base, lrt_df[, c("ENSG", "pvalue", "padj")], by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE)

  base <- unique(base[, c("SYMBOL", "ENSG", "genes", "cluster", "pvalue", "padj")])
  base[order(base$cluster, base$pvalue), ]
}

############################################################
# 4) Filter LRT genes to xCell FIRST
############################################################
filter_lrt_to_xcell <- function(lrt_table, xcell_map) {
  out <- merge(lrt_table, xcell_map, by = "SYMBOL")
  out <- unique(out[, c("SYMBOL", "ENSG", "genes", "cluster", "pvalue", "padj", "xCell_cell_type")])

  cat("LRT genes before xCell filter:", nrow(lrt_table), "\n")
  cat("LRT genes after xCell filter:", nrow(out), "\n")
  cat("Unique SYMBOLs after xCell filter:", length(unique(out$SYMBOL)), "\n")

  out[order(out$cluster, out$pvalue), ]
}

############################################################
# 5) For each Hallmark set, keep ONLY xCell-filtered LRT genes
############################################################
map_xcell_filtered_lrt_to_hallmark <- function(xcell_lrt_table, tsv_dir, pattern="\\.tsv$") {

  files <- list.files(tsv_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

  all_hits <- list()

  for (f in files) {
    set_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    hallmark_syms <- read_msigdb_tsv_symbols(f)

    cat("\n---", set_name, "---\n")
    cat("Hallmark input symbols:", length(hallmark_syms), "\n")

    hit <- xcell_lrt_table[xcell_lrt_table$SYMBOL %in% hallmark_syms, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(hit) > 0) {
      hit$geneset <- set_name
      hit <- hit[, c("geneset", "SYMBOL", "ENSG", "genes", "cluster", "pvalue", "padj", "xCell_cell_type")]

      cat("Mapped rows:", nrow(hit), "\n")
      cat("Unique SYMBOLs mapped:", length(unique(hit$SYMBOL)), "\n")

      all_hits[[set_name]] <- hit
    } else {
      cat("Mapped rows: 0\n")
    }
  }

  out <- if (length(all_hits) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_hits) else data.frame()
  out[order(out$geneset, out$cluster, out$pvalue), ]
}

############################################################
# RUN
############################################################
xcell_map  <- build_xcell_symbol_map(xcell_file)
lrt_table  <- build_lrt_cluster_table(clusters_obj = clusters_anyday, resLRT_obj = resLRT_anyday)
xcell_lrt  <- filter_lrt_to_xcell(lrt_table, xcell_map)

final_hits <- map_xcell_filtered_lrt_to_hallmark(
  xcell_lrt_table = xcell_lrt,
  tsv_dir         = tsv_dir
)

write.csv(final_hits, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nWrote combined xCell-first Hallmark mappings to:\n", out_csv, "\n")
```

```{r}
}

############################################################
# 3) Hallmark-first mapping to LRT clusters
############################################################
map_symbols_to_clusters <- function(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj) {

  symbols <- unique(trimws(as.character(symbols)))
  symbols <- symbols[nzchar(symbols)]
  if (length(symbols) == 0) return(data.frame())

  df_map <- clusters_obj$df
  stopifnot(all(c("genes","cluster") %in% colnames(df_map)))
  df_map$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", df_map$genes)

  lrt_df <- as.data.frame(resLRT_obj)
  lrt_df$ENSG <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(lrt_df))

  m <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys     = symbols,
    columns  = c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL"),
    keytype  = "SYMBOL"
  )
  m <- m[!is.na(m$SYMBOL) & !is.na(m$ENSEMBL), c("SYMBOL","ENSEMBL")]
  m <- unique(m)
  colnames(m)[colnames(m) == "ENSEMBL"] <- "ENSG"
  if (nrow(m) == 0) return(data.frame())

  hit <- merge(m, df_map[, c("genes","ENSG","cluster")], by = "ENSG")
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) return(data.frame())

  hit2 <- merge(hit, lrt_df[, c("ENSG","pvalue","padj")], by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE)

  hit2$geneset <- set_name
  hit2 <- hit2[, c("geneset","SYMBOL","ENSG","genes","cluster","pvalue","padj")]
  hit2[order(hit2$geneset, hit2$cluster, hit2$pvalue), ]
}

############################################################
# 4) Run all Hallmark TSVs against Days 1-9 LRT clusters
############################################################
run_all_msigdb_tsvs_to_clusters <- function(tsv_dir, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj, pattern="\\.tsv$") {

  files <- list.files(tsv_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

  all_hits <- list()

  for (f in files) {
    set_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    symbols  <- read_msigdb_tsv_symbols(f)

    cat("\n---", set_name, "---\n")
    cat("Input symbols:", length(symbols), "\n")

    hit2 <- map_symbols_to_clusters(symbols, set_name, clusters_obj, resLRT_obj)

    cat("Mapped rows:", nrow(hit2), "\n")
    if (nrow(hit2) > 0) {
      all_hits[[set_name]] <- hit2
    }
  }

  out <- if (length(all_hits) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_hits) else data.frame()
  out
}

############################################################
# 5) Annotate/filter Hallmark-first result with xCell
############################################################
annotate_with_xcell <- function(df, xcell_map) {
  out <- merge(df, xcell_map, by = "SYMBOL", all.x = TRUE)
  out[order(out$geneset, out$cluster, out$pvalue), ]
}

filter_hallmark_to_xcell <- function(df_annotated) {
  df_annotated[!is.na(df_annotated$xCell_cell_type) & nzchar(df_annotated$xCell_cell_type), ]
}

############################################################
# RUN: DAYS 1-9 / ANYDAY
############################################################
xcell_map <- build_xcell_symbol_map(xcell_file)

hallmark_first_anyday <- run_all_msigdb_tsvs_to_clusters(
  tsv_dir      = tsv_dir,
  clusters_obj = clusters_anyday,
  resLRT_obj   = resLRT_anyday
)

hallmark_first_anyday_annot <- annotate_with_xcell(hallmark_first_anyday, xcell_map)
hallmark_first_anyday_xcell <- filter_hallmark_to_xcell(hallmark_first_anyday_annot)

write.csv(hallmark_first_anyday_xcell, out_hallmark_first_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nWrote Days 1-9 Hallmark-first -> xCell CSV to:\n", out_hallmark_first_csv, "\n")
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Cleaner faceted boxplots of immune cell fractions by Status
############################################################

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

# -------------------------
# 1) Read merged data
# -------------------------
merged <- read.csv("/Users/chhugani/Downloads/CIBERSORTx_merged_with_metadata.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# -------------------------
# 2) Format metadata
# -------------------------
merged$Status <- factor(merged$Status, levels = c("Persistent", "Resolving"))

# -------------------------
# 3) Define metadata / non-cell-type columns
#    Add/remove names here depending on your file
# -------------------------
non_cell_cols <- c(
  "Sample",
  "Status",
  "Day",
  "Subject",
  "Age",
  "Sex",
  "Batch",
  "Platform",
  "P-value",
  "Correlation",
  "RMSE"
)

# Keep only columns that:
# 1) are NOT metadata/QC
# 2) are numeric
cell_types <- setdiff(colnames(merged), non_cell_cols)
cell_types <- cell_types[sapply(merged[cell_types], is.numeric)]

cat("Number of cell types tested:", length(cell_types), "\n")
cat("Cell types being tested:\n")
print(cell_types)

# -------------------------
# 4) Pivot to long format
# -------------------------
long_df <- merged %>%
  select(all_of(c("Sample", "Status", cell_types))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cell_types),
    names_to = "CellType",
    values_to = "Score"
  )

# -------------------------
# 5) Run Wilcoxon test for each cell type
# -------------------------
wilcox_results <- long_df %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    n_persistent = sum(Status == "Persistent" & !is.na(Score)),
    n_resolving  = sum(Status == "Resolving" & !is.na(Score)),
    median_persistent = median(Score[Status == "Persistent"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_resolving  = median(Score[Status == "Resolving"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = wilcox.test(Score ~ Status)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      median_persistent > median_resolving ~ "Higher in Persistent",
      median_persistent < median_resolving ~ "Higher in Resolving",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# -------------------------
# 6) Save full results
# -------------------------
write.csv(
  wilcox_results,
  "CIBERSORTx_wilcox_results_FDR.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -------------------------
# 7) Save significant-only results
# -------------------------
sig_results <- wilcox_results %>%
  filter(significant)

write.csv(
  sig_results,
  "CIBERSORTx_wilcox_results_FDR_significant_only.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -------------------------
# 8) Print results
# -------------------------
cat("\nFull Wilcoxon + FDR results:\n")
print(wilcox_results)

cat("\nSignificant cell types after BH/FDR:\n")
print(sig_results)

# -------------------------
# 9) Optional: preview top hits
# -------------------------
wilcox_results %>%
  select(CellType, median_persistent, median_resolving, p_value, p_adj, direction, significant) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
